About the position

LTS is seeking a System Administrator - Endpoint Engineering to join their team and support a program with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). This role is responsible for managing and supporting enterprise Windows endpoints, device management systems, and endpoint security tools. The ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise Windows environments, endpoint management, and systems administration. This position is onsite at the client offices in Albany, NY.

Responsibilities

Manage and support enterprise Windows endpoints, device management systems, and endpoint security tools.Maintain operating system (OS) configurations.Deploy updates and software, enforcing compliance, and ensuring device performance.Troubleshoot, log analysis and debugging to quickly resolve user reported issues and maintain a secure, reliable endpoint environment.Remotely access government managed systems to diagnose and resolve SCCM related endpoint issues.Manage and prioritize trouble ticket queues; perform trend and root cause analysis; document all actions in the ticketing system.Monitor assets using SCCM, SCOM, and related tools to ensure service availability and restore systems to normal operation after maintenance windows.Prepare and distribute Situational Reports and Executive Summaries for critical service outages when required.Communicate clearly with customers, stakeholders, and technical teams; lead technical discussions and present briefing materials aligned with VA requirements. Provide a status report before and after remediation actions are engineered and executed.Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in computer science, electronics engineering or other engineering or technical discipline. 8 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education.4-7 years of experience engineering robust solutions for large-scale deployment of software using OS deployment technologies such as Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM).4-7 years of experience providing SCCM administration and patch management support services for enterprise servers and client workstations. Troubleshoot and resolve SCCM issues related to server/workstation patches and configurations by supporting, but not limited to, scheduled maintenance events.4-7 years of experience implementing, updating, and maintaining enterprise level configuration management automated software and security configuration applications and packages to support all network systems.4-7 years of experience analyzing the current enterprise configuration management implementation and adjusting the administrative environment as necessary to continuously enhance the effectiveness of deployments and patching levels.4-7 years of experience providing Tier 3 support services as required to maintain and troubleshoot enterprise level products and services, including hardware (servers, clients, mobile devices) and software (Microsoft AD, Exchange, SCCM, SCOM) used to support systems worldwide.Experience validating deployment plans for compliance of the enterprise server and workstation software and security updates.Experience troubleshooting sites experiencing configuration management problems and documenting any known issues or inefficiencies.Ability to obtain Public Trust Clearance at the Department of Veterans Affairs.Excellent verbal and written communication skills.U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident required.Nice-to-haves

Previous experience at the Department of Veterans Affairs is preferred.Understand application deployments and configuration within Microsoft Intune.Participate in co-management or hybrid scenarios if applicable.Benefits

Comprehensive benefits for you and your family

jobs.title: Intune Engineer
jobs.summary: About the position We are seeking an Endpoint Management Engineer to design, automate, and operate the enterprise device management platform supporting our global workforce, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and commercial field organization. This role...
jobs.description:
About the position

We are seeking an Endpoint Management Engineer to design, automate, and operate the enterprise device management platform supporting our global workforce, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and commercial field organization. This role owns hands-on engineering and operations across Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in a co-management architecture, with Hybrid Entra ID (Azure AD) joined, Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints and a multi-platform Intune estate spanning Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android — including Android-based teleconferencing and conference room systems.
Automation is central to this role. The successful candidate writes production-quality PowerShell, Bash, and .NET code, builds Intune remediation and detection scripts, and uses the Microsoft Graph API to manage the estate programmatically rather than soley through the console. We also expect fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools — including Claude or CoPilot — to accelerate script development, log analysis, documentation, and reporting.
Equally important is the discipline required in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will advance modern management objectives — Zero Trust, Conditional Access, cloud-first policy delivery, and progressive workload migration from Configuration Manager to Intune — while respecting the reliability requirements of standard corporate devices and the constraints of non-standard, purpose-built systems such as laboratory instrument controllers, manufacturing workstations, kiosks, and validated GxP endpoints. The role partners closely with Information Security, Identity, Networking, Infrastructure, Site IT, and Site Service Support teams.

Responsibilities

Design, write, and maintain production-quality PowerShell for endpoint provisioning, configuration enforcement, bulk administration, reporting, and incident remediation across the Windows estate.Write and maintain shell/Bash scripts for macOS configuration, compliance validation, and application delivery through Intune macOS shell scripting.Build and manage Intune Remediations (proactive remediations) — paired detection and remediation script logic — to identify and self-heal configuration drift, failed agents, certificate issues, and compliance gaps without user impact.Automate platform operations against the Microsoft Graph API, including device and policy inventory, assignment management, application lifecycle tasks, reporting extracts, and integration with adjacent systems.Apply engineering discipline to automation assets: source control, code review, parameterization, error handling, logging, idempotency, and controlled release through test rings.Convert recurring manual and Service Desk activities into automated or self-service capabilities.Engineer and maintain Intune compliance policies across all platforms, including device health, OS version floors, and custom compliance scripts.Build and maintain configuration profiles and settings catalog policies, administrative templates, and custom OMA-URI/configuration profiles for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android.Familiar with Windows Update for Business and update rings, feature and quality update deployments, driver and firmware update governance, macOS and iOS update policies.Manage monthly and out-of-band patch operations in Configuration Manager through Software Update Groups, automatic deployment rules, and maintenance windows; drive patch compliance to defined service-level targets and remediate delinquent endpoints.Package, test, and deploy applications across platforms — Win32 (.intunewin), MSI/MSIX, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 Apps, macOS PKG/DMG and shell-script apps, iOS/Android managed apps via volume purchasing — with correct detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, requirement rules, and assignment logic.Implement and maintain security baselines and industry benchmarks — Microsoft security baselines for Windows, Edge, and Defender; CIS Benchmarks; DISA STIG-derived controls — including deviation tracking, exception documentation, and drift detection.Administer the Configuration Manager hierarchy: site systems, distribution points, boundary groups, client health, content distribution, task sequences, OS deployment, and hardware/software inventory accuracy.Manage non-standard Windows endpoints — laboratory instrument PCs, manufacturing and shop-floor workstations, kiosks, shared and standalone systems — with tailored collections, restricted patch windows, exception handling, and documented deviations.Manage device identity across Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including Hybrid Entra ID join, Entra ID join, AD domain-bound systems, and resolution of stale, duplicate, or mis-registered device objects.Configure and maintain co-management settings, pilot collections, and the controlled transition of individual workloads (compliance policies, Windows Update, device configuration, client apps, Office Apps) from Configuration Manager to Intune.Support Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security: device-based and compliance-based grant controls, filters for devices, app protection policy requirements, and safe rollout using report-only mode and exclusion groups.Understand and support macOS Platform SSO with Entra ID — Secure Enclave authentication, local account creation and password sync, registration during Automated Device Enrollment — and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in for macOS and iOS/iPadOS.Familiar with Zscaler Client Connector or comparable Zero Trust network access and secure web gateway agents across Windows and macOS.Familiar with endpoint security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker and FileVault encryption with key escrow, application control, firewall policy, and Windows LAPS.Deploy and maintain certificate profiles (SCEP/PKCS) and Wi-Fi (including 802.1X) across all supported platforms.Define, publish, and maintain endpoint management KPIs — patch compliance rate and time-to-patch, policy and compliance conformance, application deployment success rate, agent and client health.Build operational and executive dashboards using Intune reporting, Configuration Manager reporting and SQL, Log Analytics, Microsoft Graph data extracts, and PowerBI.Use AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Cowork, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable agentic tooling — to accelerate script and policy development, log and error triage, documentation authoring, data analysis, and report generation.Execute all platform and policy changes through the enterprise change management process, with documented impact assessment, test evidence, approvals, and rollback plans.Support GxP-regulated endpoints by respecting validated system boundaries, coordinating with appropriate groups on change impact, and maintaining documentation sufficient to withstand internal audit and regulatory inspection.Serve as escalation point for complex endpoint incidents from Endpoint Engineering Operations team and regional IT teams; perform root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.Maintain accurate technical documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge base articles.Participate in an on-call or extended-coverage rotation for critical endpoint incidents and scheduled maintenance activities.Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience with relevant certifications will be considered.Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in an enterprise environment, including application packaging, OS deployment, and software update management.Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines, and application deployment.Demonstrated proficiency writing and maintaining PowerShell for endpoint automation, remediation, and reporting — beyond running scripts written by others.Practical experience with the Microsoft Graph API for endpoint management automation or reporting.Working knowledge of Intune and Configuration Manager co-management, workload transition, Hybrid Entra ID join, and Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints.Hands-on experience managing at least two non-Windows platforms in Intune (macOS, iOS/iPadOS, or Android), including scripting or shell-based configuration on macOS.Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, Group Policy, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, PKI and certificate services, and Windows client architecture.Experience deploying and troubleshooting endpoint security and network access agents (for example, Zscaler Client Connector, CrowdStrike).Experience using endpoint reporting and analytics to measure and improve device health, compliance, or user experience (for example Intune report dashboards, Nexthink).Working familiarity with AI-assisted development and productivity tools, and sound judgment about their appropriate use with enterprise data.Experience operating within formal change management, incident management, and documentation standards.Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills spanning identity, network, policy, and apBenefits

Medical, dental & visionCritical Illness, Accident, and Hospital401(k) Retirement Plan – Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions availableLife Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents)Short and long-term disabilityHealth Spending Account (HSA)Transportation benefitsEmployee Assistance ProgramTime Off/Leave (PTO, Vacation or Sick Leave)

jobs.description:
Senior macOS System Engineer

$110000 - $125000 per year | Charlotte, NC | On-site | Permanent

A bit about us:

We are a large, established organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses and a global technology environment. Our enterprise technology teams build and support the secure, reliable, and modern platforms that enable employees to work effectively across locations and business units.

The Endpoint Engineering team is responsible for delivering scalable device-management solutions, strengthening endpoint security, and modernizing the employee technology experience. The team works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, and Support teams to ensure endpoint services remain secure, resilient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to serve as a senior technical authority for macOS engineering within a complex, large-scale enterprise environment. You will have the ability to shape endpoint strategy, lead modernization and automation initiatives, and influence how Apple devices are securely managed throughout their lifecycle.

You will join a collaborative technology organization where you can:

Take ownership of enterprise macOS engineering and platform architecture

Lead high-impact automation, security, and modernization initiatives

Work with modern endpoint-management and cloud-identity technologies

Solve complex technical challenges across a large, distributed environment

Partner with experienced professionals across Security, Identity, Infrastructure, and Networking

Mentor other engineers and help establish endpoint-engineering standards and best practices

Job Details

Position Overview

The Senior macOS Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, maintaining, automating, and securing the organization’s macOS endpoint ecosystem and its supporting infrastructure. This individual will serve as a senior technical resource for macOS device management, endpoint security, automation, and enterprise client-engineering initiatives.

As a member of the Endpoint Engineering team, this role will focus on delivering scalable, secure, and modern management solutions for macOS devices across a global enterprise environment. Responsibilities include endpoint lifecycle management, operating-system deployment, application packaging, software distribution, patch management, security compliance, automation, and platform optimization.

The ideal candidate brings deep macOS platform expertise, strong engineering and scripting capabilities, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives while maintaining the stability and reliability of critical endpoint services.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

Serve as the senior macOS subject-matter expert for endpoint-engineering operations, technical initiatives, and escalations.

Engineer, administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise macOS management platforms, including Jamf Pro and Iru.

Design scalable endpoint-provisioning and lifecycle-management workflows integrated with cloud-based identity environments.

Manage macOS operating-system deployment, configuration management, software distribution, and patch-management processes.

Establish and maintain standardized endpoint configurations across the enterprise.

Implement and enforce device-compliance policies and enterprise technology standards.

Evaluate platform capabilities and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, security, and the employee experience.

Automation and Scripting

Develop and maintain scripts, tooling, and automated workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.

Create and maintain application packages, deployment automations, and self-service software-delivery solutions.

Write advanced Bash and Python scripts supporting device provisioning, compliance, reporting, monitoring, remediation, and lifecycle management.

Identify opportunities to automate repeatable processes and improve the overall maturity of endpoint operations.

Build reliable and reusable solutions that can scale across a large enterprise environment.

Security and Compliance

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

IT Support & Infrastructure Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced IT Infrastructure & Support Engineer to join the Development Tools IT Team at Sony Interactive Entertainment.

This is a senior hands-on internal IT role supporting approximately 120 users across Bristol and Dublin, most of whom are developers and highly technical staff. You will work as part of a small IT team responsible for local support, infrastructure operations, security remediation, monitoring and project delivery.

The role is ideal for an experienced senior support engineer, infrastructure support engineer, systems engineer or 3rd line engineer who enjoys broad technical ownership and hands-on problem solving.

You will act as a key senior technical person within the team. You will take ownership of complex support issues, support and administer local infrastructure, help improve patching and vulnerability remediation, contribute to infrastructure projects, and provide guidance to less senior team members where appropriate.

This is not a narrowly defined project-only role. Because we are a small team, everyone gets involved where needed. While there is significant exposure to infrastructure and project work, you should also be comfortable helping with user-facing support and advanced desktop issues.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Acting as a senior technical escalation point within the local IT team.

- Taking ownership of complex 2nd and 3rd line support tickets.

- Troubleshooting advanced Windows desktop, Linux and MacOS endpoint, server and infrastructure issues.

- Supporting Windows 11 laptops, desktops and developer workstations.

- Providing support for Linux and MacOS endpoints.

- Supporting Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services and Remote Desktop Services.

- Assisting with local domain administration and Group Policy improvements.

- Supporting VMware administration, including managing and building virtual machines and managing ESXi hosts.

- Supporting migration to Proxmox hypervisor

- Troubleshooting issues involving DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs and firewalls.

- Supporting a Juniper switching and Palo Alto firewall environment.

- Working with global SIE teams where services are centrally managed.

- Supporting vulnerability remediation and patching using tools such as KACE, Qualys and Domo.

- Investigating patch failures and working with users to resolve remediation issues.

- Supporting endpoint security processes involving tools such as CrowdStrike.

- Monitoring systems and alerts using Zabbix.

- Helping shape and improve IT alerting processes.

- Supporting backup and recovery processes using Commvault.

- Creating and maintaining documentation, troubleshooting guides and runbooks in Confluence.

- Supporting infrastructure improvement projects.

- Working alongside wider internal IT functions

- Helping guide and support the Desktop Support Engineer where appropriate.

- Helping reduce IT friction for a highly technical developer user base.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone with strong technical support and infrastructure experience, excellent troubleshooting ability, and the confidence to act as a senior technical person within a small IT team.

You should have:

- Proven experience in a senior 2nd line, 3rd line, infrastructure support, systems support or similar role.

- Experience collaborating with wider support and technical teams

- Excellent Windows11 support and troubleshooting skills.

- Hands-on Windows Server support and administration experience.

- Experience with Active Directory and Group Policy.

- Good understanding of DNS, DHCP, file services and permissions.

- Good networking fundamentals, including subnets, VLANs, switching, routing, VPNs and firewalls.

- Hands-on VMware administration experience.

- Confidence managing and building virtual machines.

- Understanding of patch management and vulnerability remediation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Confidence investigating issues thoroughly rather than simply escalating them.

- Experience taking ownership of complex technical issues.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Good documentation habits.

- Ability to prioritise work in a busy technical environment.

- Willingness to work across support levels in a small team.

- Confidence supporting highly technical users.

- A genuine interest in improving systems, processes and infrastructure maturity.

Desirable Skills

Any of the following would be useful but are not essential:

- Linux support or administration experience.

- macOS support experience.

- Juniper switching experience.

- Palo Alto firewall exposure.

- Commvault backup experience.

- Zabbix monitoring experience.

- Tanium experience.

- Perforce experience.

- KACE patching experience.

- Qualys vulnerability management experience.

- Domo reporting experience.

- CrowdStrike experience.

- PowerShell scripting.

- General scripting or automation experience.

- Proxmox experience.

- ESXi host build or management experience.

- ITIL knowledge.

- Experience supporting developers or technical engineering users.

- Experience working in a larger enterprise environment with central or global IT teams.

- Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers.

About You

You will be someone who:

- Enjoys troubleshooting and technical problem solving.

- Is calm, methodical and analytical.

- Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical users.

- Is comfortable supporting highly technical developers.

- Takes ownership of issues and follows them through.

- Documents fixes and shares knowledge.

- Is organised and able to manage competing priorities.

- Wants to own and improve the environment around them.

- Is happy working in a small team where everyone helps where needed.

- Wants to improve systems and processes, not just close tickets.

- Can work pragmatically in an environment where users have complex tools and local admin rights.

- Is comfortable acting as a senior technical presence within the team.

Working Pattern and Out-of-Hours

Expected work pattern, 3 days per week in the Bristol office. 2 day flexible working from home depending on business requirements.

There is no formal on-call rota for this role.

Occasional evening or weekend maintenance may be required for planned work such as infrastructure changes, patching or upgrades. Time off in lieu is provided for approved out-of-hours work.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

Briviant Inc. is a rapidly growing technology company delivering cloud infrastructure and AI-powered solutions to customers around the world. We are seeking a Systems Engineer – macOS & AI Operations to join our Infrastructure team.

You'll provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support while helping improve and train our internal AI support systems. The ideal candidate enjoys solving technical problems, improving operational processes, and leveraging AI to deliver exceptional customer support.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build expertise in both systems engineering and artificial intelligence.

This position is remote within the State of California. Employees must maintain an approved work location.

Position Summary
As a Systems Engineer, you'll support our hosted macOS infrastructure and customer environments while contributing to the development and continuous improvement of AI-powered support tools.
You'll troubleshoot customer issues, administer macOS systems, maintain technical documentation, evaluate AI-generated responses, and help improve our AI knowledge base and automated support workflows.

Success in this role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, excellent customer communication, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support for hosted macOS environments.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, virtualization, and operating system issues.

Monitor infrastructure health and proactively resolve issues before customer impact.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring technical issues.
Document resolutions and maintain accurate technical documentation.

Troubleshoot issues remotely using remote administration tools.
Escalate complex technical issues when appropriate.
Meet established service level objectives for response and resolution times.

Train and improve internal AI support systems using real-world support cases.
Review and validate AI-generated responses for technical accuracy and completeness.
Create and maintain AI knowledge base content and technical documentation.
Identify recurring support trends to improve AI performance.
Test new AI workflows, prompts, and support automations before deployment.
Recommend improvements to AI-assisted customer support processes.

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks.
Create and maintain standard operating procedures and technical documentation.
Collaborate with engineering teams to improve internal support tools.
Evaluate emerging technologies that improve infrastructure management and customer experience.

Qualifications

2–4 years of strong experience supporting macOS environments in a technical support or systems administration role.
Strong troubleshooting skills across macOS, networking, and desktop applications.
Experience using ticketing platforms such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, or similar.
Experience with Bash, Python, or PowerShell scripting.

jobs.description:
The Application Analyst provides system analysis, configuration, maintenance, administration, and day-to-day support of assigned enterprise applications to ensure reliability, security, and high-quality service delivery across the MBTA. This role serves as a subject matter expert for functional and technical components of assigned platforms, troubleshooting issues, resolving incidents, and coordinating escalations with vendors and partner technology teams.

The Application Analyst monitors system performance, maintains documentation, supports upgrades, and ensures data integrity in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. This position also supports audits and compliance activities, and serves as a key liaison between IT, end-users, and business stakeholders, delivering responsive and professional service.

Digital Workplace

This role will focus on specialized Enterprise Application platforms that support the core workflows of our organization’s departments, such as Comply365, Microsoft Power Platform for workflow automation, HR, Learning, and Document Management systems, as well as related data integration between these and other enterprise systems.

This is a term-limited and project-specific contractor position that is not employed directly by the MBTA. This hybrid position requires being in the office at least two (2) days per week.Provide day-to-day application support for assigned platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, including user access, synchronization, and performance problems.

Serve as a primary point of contact for application-related incidents, service requests, and user inquiries.

Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for all functional and technical aspects of the applications and associated technical components.

Partner with other team members on any application functional or technical issues or questions.

Provide third level support for application issues, including issues with application functionality, environment configuration, and / or system integrations.

Coordinate with relevant software vendor(s) to escalate and resolve complex issues.

Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.

Monitor system health and logs to ensure availability and reliability.

Assist with application upgrades, patches, testing, and release validation.

Collaborate with partner technology teams to ensure proper integration with other enterprise systems.

Develop and maintain application documentation, support procedures, and knowledge base articles.

Monitor and validate user access provisioning / deprovisioning, roles, permissions, and access controls.

Ensure data integrity and security within the platform, following organizational and regulatory standards.

Support audits and compliance activities related to application controls and regulatory requirements.

Participate in disaster recovery planning.

Handle sensitive and confidential information in an appropriate manner.

Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or co-worker, in a courteous and professional manner

Participate in the on-call support rotation, responding to emergencies on a twenty-four (24) hour, seven (7) day per week basis while on-call.

Work any and all shifts and / or locations as assigned or directed, including occasional night and / or weekend work. · Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Available to work any and all shifts and/or locations as assigned or directed.

Available to work as per assignment by the MBTA twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week as directed by supervisory staff for severe weather conditions, emergencies or any other circumstances that may potentially impact service or the safety of service.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No direct reports.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited instituition.

Three (3) years of experience in system analysis, including enterprise application design, configuration / development, implementation, and support.

Proven ability to map and document complex business processes and identify opportunities for optimization or automation within assigned applications.

Experience identifying and documenting business rules and technical requirements.

Foundational knowledge of cloud-based application delivery models such as Software as a Service (SaaS) and / or technology infrastructure concepts.

Experience with IT service management / ticketing systems.

Strong interpersonal skills to interact with stakeholders, vendors, team members, and end-users.

Ability to work with many different types of professionals in a fast-paced environment.

Ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce and end-user community.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams).

Effective organizational, analytical, multi-tasking, time management, and documentation skills.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts for end-users.

Excellent customer service and conflict resolution skills.

Experience with enterprise applications. Application expertise: Proven experience in the administration, configuration, and support of enterprise-level digital workplace applications (e.g., Comply365, Document Management System, Human Resources (HR), Learning Management System (LMS), Identity Provider (IDP), and Power Platform, etc.).

Power Platform Proficiency: Direct experience developing, governing, or administering solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate and/or Power Apps).

Integration Skills: Foundational knowledge and experience with Application Programming Interface (API) management, system connectors, or data integration tools/middleware.

Microsoft 365 Core Knowledge: Strong conceptual understanding of M365 governance, security, and integration points (SharePoint Online, Teams, etc.).

Compliance Application Deep Dive: Specific hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting Comply365 or similar enterprise-level Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) or Quality Management Systems (QMS).

Data and Reporting Tools: Experience using reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to extract meaningful operational and compliance data from the managed applications.

Analytics and Metrics: Experience defining, tracking, and reporting on key Digital Workplace KPIs, such as user engagement rates, service utilization, adoption progress, and platform Return on Investment (ROI).

Experience or interest in the public transit or transportation industry.

Substitutions

A high school diploma or GED with an additional seven (7) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

An associate’s degree from an accredited institution and an additional three (3) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

A master’s degree in a related subject substitutes for two (2) years of general experience.

A nationally recognized certification, or statewide/professional certification in a related field substitutes for one (1) year of experience.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

- Approach all rollouts with a strong user experience focus. Phasing thoughtfully, communicating proactively, and designing for minimal disruption

- Contribute to designing and implementing best practices, policies, and procedures for the Device Infrastructure Services team

- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization

- Be available for occasional 24/7 on-call shifts to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve incidents.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.

We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a cleared DevOps Engineer to join our mission-focused team supporting complex deployments. The ideal candidate will have deep experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), advanced networking, and hands-on proficiency with Puppet, Ansible, and CI/CD. In this role, you will install, configure, and troubleshoot both test and production environments, while identifying opportunities to enhance and modernize our primarily Puppet-based deployment pipelines. This is a hands-on, high-impact engineering role where your contributions directly influence our delivery capabilities. Candidates should thrive in fast-paced environments and balance operational reliability with automation, security, and scalability.

Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain RHEL-based environments to support operational deployments
* Develop and maintain automation and configuration management solutions using Puppet and Ansible
* Support Tier 3/4 escalations, performing deep-dive troubleshooting across infrastructure and application layers
* Improve deployment processes and reduce manual interventions through scripting and tool integration
* Collaborate with software developers, infrastructure teams, and cybersecurity engineers to deliver secure, scalable systems
* Document installation procedures, troubleshooting guides, and deployment workflows
* Assist with maintaining CI/CD pipelines and monitoring solutions to ensure production reliability
* Implement security features and address newly identified vulnerabilities and best practices

Qualifications Required

* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility

* Bachelor’s and/or Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline
* Minimum of 5 years of experience or an equivalent combination of education, skills, and experience
* Proficiency with Puppet and Ansible for configuration management and automation
* Understanding of Agile development practices, DevOps methodologies, and secure software delivery principles
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar)
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools (Git, GitLab, Jenkins)
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Bash, Python)
* Excellent troubleshooting skills across OS, network, and application layers

Desired

* An active Top Secret with SCI clearance
* Experience with AWS and cloud architecture principles
* Familiarity with Helm charts and Kubernetes deployments; willingness to stand up and maintain Kubernetes clusters

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .

As a Senior IT Support Engineer on the IT Tooling team within IT Support & Services (ITSS), you'll own the technical architecture behind the automations that power IT operations at Coinbase. This team builds the self-service workflows, bots, and integrations that employees interact with daily, from ticket triage and access reviews to onboarding and offboarding. You'll drive architecture decisions across platforms like n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira, and Okta, partnering with regional IT teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER to deliver high-impact automation at scale.

What you’ll do:

- Own the technical architecture of IT Tooling automations, driving design decisions on system structure, integration patterns, and platform standards across n8n, Airflow, Temporal, and Jira

- Lead the most complex automation projects end-to-end as technical DRI, from discovery and design through production delivery

- Partner with Security, Corporate Engineering, and IAM teams to resolve technical blockers and represent IT Tooling in cross-functional architecture discussions

- Build shared frameworks, reusable components, and architecture documentation that reduce single points of failure and raise the team's engineering bar

- Establish code review practices and engineering standards that elevate quality across the IT Tooling platform

Required skills and experience:

- 5+ years in IT engineering, automation, or systems engineering, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions and platform-level systems others build on top of

- Deep expertise building and maintaining complex automations with n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira Automation, or Workato, plus strong Git-based development workflows (branching, CI/CD, code review)

- Working knowledge of Okta, Slack API, and Google Workspace administration sufficient to design secure, scalable automation architecture

- Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, translating loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specs and clear architecture decision records

- Experience mentoring peers and writing technical design documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
Join a team focused on strengthening and scaling iOS device deployment operations through Microsoft Intune in a large enterprise environment. This role is ideal for an Intune specialist who enjoys improving reliability, building repeatable processes, and creating the visibility needed to support secure mobile device management at scale.

Remote (PST & EST preferred)

Responsibilities

Audit existing Microsoft Intune configurations for iOS app deployment, app protection, app configuration, VPP/ABM integration, and rollout settings.
Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities to improve the reliability and repeatability of mobile app deployments.
Implement process improvements for app version management, phased rollouts, and rollback procedures across managed devices.
Partner with mobile engineering and IT teams to document and operationalize deployment workflows.
Build and support pre-release validation for Intune-deployed builds across MAM/MDM policies, conditional access, enrollment paths, device types, and OS versions.
Create monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and reports to track deployment success, install issues, policy compliance, and version adoption.
Support cross-functional collaboration by translating technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Help establish a stable foundation for ongoing operational support after the initial assessment and buildout phase.

Skills

Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune for iOS in an enterprise setting.
Strong knowledge of mobile device management, including enrollment, authentication, compliance, certification, and security practices.
Deep understanding of the Apple ecosystem, including ABM, VPP, APNs certificates, and app distribution.
Proven ability to support large-scale device management environments with complex requirements.
Experience advising on Intune architecture, deployment approaches, and operational best practices.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to collaborate effectively with support, product, engineering, and customer success teams.
Comfort working as a trusted subject matter expert in a consultative role.

Preferred Skills

Experience supporting enterprise-grade iOS environments in organizations with complex mobility needs.
Familiarity with building dashboards, alerts, and runbooks for deployment operations.
Experience with testing and validating policy behavior across a variety of device and OS configurations.
Background working in environments where repeatable processes and operational scaling are priorities.
Ability to thrive in a fast-moving setting with a focus on documentation, process improvement, and cross-team alignment.

Position: Desktop Engineer - End User Computing Specialist

Location: Jersey City, NJ

Hiring: W2 Contract

Job Description:

Overview: As an End User Computing Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing the end-user computing environment within our organization. Your role will focus on ensuring that all users have reliable access to the necessary technology resources, providing technical support, and implementing solutions to enhance user productivity and satisfaction.

Working Conditions:

This role typically operates in an office environment, with occasional travel to different locations as needed.May require flexibility in working hours to accommodate after-hours support or project deadlines.Conclusion: Join our team as an End User Computing Specialist and contribute to the optimization and support of our organization s end-user computing environment.This role offers opportunities to leverage your technical expertise, drive innovation, and ensure that our users have reliable access to technology resources that enable them to perform their roles effectively.If you are passionate about technology and delivering exceptional user experiences, we invite you to apply and be a part of our dynamic team.

Responsibilities:

Technical Support and Issue Resolution:

Serve as a subject matter expert for all end-user computing technologies, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and associated software.Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical support for complex issues escalated from Level 1 and Level 2 support teams.Ensure timely resolution of critical incidents to minimize downtime and impact on business operations.System Administration and Optimization:

Manage and maintain desktop operating systems (e.g., Windows, macOS) and software applications, ensuring they are up-to-date and secure.Implement and maintain endpoint management solutions for efficient software distribution, patch management, and remote support.Optimize end-user computing environments to enhance performance, reliability, and security.User Training and Documentation:

Develop and deliver training sessions and workshops to educate users on best practices for using technology tools and applications effectively.Create and update documentation, user guides, and knowledge base articles to empower users to troubleshoot common issues independently.Security and Compliance:

Implement and enforce security policies and procedures to protect end-user devices, data, and systems from security threats.Conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and organizational standards.Technology Evaluation and Implementation:

Research, evaluate, and recommend new technologies, tools, and solutions to improve end-user computing capabilities and user experience.Lead or participate in projects related to the deployment, integration, and migration of end-user computing systems and applications.Customer Service and Relationship Management:

Foster positive relationships with end users and stakeholders, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through responsive and effective support.Communicate technical information and updates to non-technical users in a clear and understandable manner.Requirements:

Proven experience as an End User Computing Specialist, Desktop Support Engineer, or similar role, with a strong technical background in supporting end-user technologies.In-depth knowledge of desktop operating systems, productivity software (e.g., Microsoft Office, collaboration tools), and endpoint security principles.Experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., SCCM, Jamf, Intune) and remote support technologies.Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues independently.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach.Bachelor s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field;relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate) are a plus.

jobs.description:
Thinking Machines Lab's mission is to empower humanity through advancing collaborative general intelligence. We're building a future where everyone has access to the knowledge and tools to make AI work for their unique needs and goals.
We are scientists, engineers, and builders who’ve created some of the most widely used AI products, including ChatGPT and Character.ai, open-weights models like Mistral, as well as popular open source projects like PyTorch, OpenAI Gym, Fairseq, and Segment Anything.
About the Team
The IT team builds secure infrastructure and efficient processes that enable our employees to move quickly. We operate an all-Mac environment and manage our endpoint fleet as a distributed platform, applying production-engineering practices to device management and security.
Our endpoint configurations, security policies, scripts, and software deployments are increasingly managed through version-controlled workflows with testing, review, staged rollouts, and rollback capabilities. This role will work closely with IT, Security, Identity, and Infrastructure to deliver a secure and reliable employee computing experience.
What You’ll Do

Endpoint Configuration as Code: Author, review, test, and progressively deploy macOS configuration profiles, security policies, queries, and remediation scripts. Build code review, staging, canary, validation, and rollback processes into endpoint changes.
MDM Platform Engineering: Operate our MDM platform as a production service, including configuration as code, observability, upgrades, reliability, incident response, and integrations with other IT and Security systems.
MDM Migration: Lead the evaluation, design, testing, and execution of our planned migration from Iru to Fleet. Establish functional requirements, identify configuration and security-control gaps, develop a phased migration plan, and move the fleet with minimal disruption to employees.
Santa and Rudolph: Own the architecture and operation of Santa and its Rudolph synchronization service. Manage binary-authorization policies, rule distribution, application approvals, telemetry, observability, infrastructure, and incident response.
Zero Trust and Device Trust: Partner closely with Security and Identity to make device trust a core component of our Zero Trust architecture. Integrate endpoint posture signals into authentication, authorization, and conditional-access decisions.
Continuous Posture Evaluation: Build systems that continuously evaluate device health and security posture, including MDM enrollment, OS version, patch status, disk encryption, endpoint protection, security-control status, and configuration compliance. Automatically identify and remediate drift or restrict access when a device no longer meets requirements.
Patch Management: Build and maintain automated macOS patching workflows that support rapid enforcement timelines while providing a thoughtful employee experience.
Zero-Touch Provisioning: Design and improve Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment workflows that turn a new Mac into a secure, fully configured, and productive machine with minimal manual intervention.
Software Distribution: Own application packaging, deployment, updating, and removal across the Mac fleet.
Fleet Telemetry and Compliance: Query live device state at scale and turn endpoint telemetry into actionable policies, dashboards, compliance reporting, and early warnings for configuration drift.
Automation: Build tools and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive operational work and make endpoint management more reliable and scalable.
Endpoint Security: Partner with Security on macOS hardening, binary authorization, vulnerability management, compliance controls, detection and response, and device-based access policies.
Advanced Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex macOS and endpoint-platform issues that cannot be resolved through standard IT support processes.
Technical Leadership: Help define the endpoint roadmap, evaluate technologies, make architecture decisions, and lead complex initiatives from conception through production.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience building and operating secure IT or endpoint systems in complex environments.
Experience managing a large fleet of macOS devices through a modern MDM platform.
Experience managing endpoint configuration through scripted deployments, Git-based workflows, or a full GitOps model.
Deep knowledge of macOS internals, enterprise deployment, security controls, and troubleshooting.
Experience designing and operating zero-touch Mac provisioning, patching, and software-distribution workflows.
Experience using device health and security signals to evaluate endpoint compliance.
Experience successfully delivering complex technical projects from conception through production.
Strong ability to solve ambiguous problems involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
Ability to communicate

- Leverage various APIs to write scripts and applications to automate IT Operations

- Support and work with IT, Security and other internal departments by building automation for repetitive tasks

- Write detailed and concise documentation and runbooks

- Be a mentor to others in IT and act as a source for others

- Scripting experience leveraging GAM, Python, Bash, and/or equivalent tools

- Comfortable consuming REST APIs

- Experience administering Okta via Terraform

- Experience with GitOps

- Familiarity with open ID connect, SAML, and Oauth is required.

- Experience building integrations across various systems leveraging APIs with both low code/no code solutions using platforms like Okta workflows and Workato

- Experience writing and documenting detailed project proposals

- Experience working with vendors to solve issues, project roadmaps, and implement improvements

- Ability to adapt and solve problems in a fast moving environment

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to collaborate and work with others

- Experience with MDMs, jamf, NinjaOne, Omnissa

Windows Engineer III – TS/SCI Clearance Required – JBSA Lackland - San Antonio, TX

Job Description

The Windows Engineer III serves as the senior Windows infrastructure engineer responsible for the design, implementation, administration, sustainment, and modernization of Microsoft Windows Server environments supporting the Department of the Air Force's Defensive Cyberspace Operations Weapon Systems. The position ensures secure, highly available, and resilient enterprise Windows infrastructure supporting 24x7 cyber operations while maintaining compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements, RMF, and DISA STIGs.

Job Responsibilities

Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise Microsoft Windows Server environments.
Administer Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and Microsoft infrastructure services.
Support operating system deployments, migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.
Integrate Windows infrastructure with virtualization, storage, and cloud environments.
Administer Windows Server operating systems across multiple security enclaves.
Manage enterprise authentication, file, print, and certificate services.
Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, backup, and disaster recovery.
Implement DISA STIG-compliant configurations.
Support RMF, A&A, vulnerability remediation, POA&M activities, and audit readiness.
Apply security patches and maintain secure baselines.
Provide Tier III engineering support for enterprise Windows infrastructure.
Respond to outages and infrastructure failures.
Support maintenance windows, COOP testing, and mission travel.
Develop automation using PowerShell and Desired State Configuration (DSC).
Support infrastructure automation, Checklist-as-Code, and modernization initiatives.

Basic Qualifications

Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline. Equivalent experience may be substituted.

Certification: CASP+, CCNP Security, CCSP, GCIA, GCED, GCIH, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) (or equivalent Microsoft enterprise certification)

Experience:

Minimum of 8 years of enterprise Windows Server engineering experience.
Experience supporting DoD, Federal, or large enterprise environments.
Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, PowerShell, VMware integration, backup and recovery, and enterprise patch management.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience engineering and sustaining Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure supporting Department of the Air Force DCO systems or comparable 24x7 DoD mission environments.
Advanced expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, VMware integration, enterprise patch management, backup and recovery, and disaster-recovery planning.
Demonstrated experience automating Windows infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and security compliance using PowerShell, Desired State Configuration, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Checklist-as-Code methodologies.

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, Unlimited Vacation, Sick Leave, Paid Federal Holidays, Education and Certification Reimbursement Program, 401(k) retirement plan with safe harbor employer match after 3 months, Prepaid Legal Plan and Identity Protection Plan available, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance available.

This role serves as a technical resource for the implementation, management, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, and related end-user services. Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Engineer collaborates closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to maintain reliable, secure, and efficient EUC services. The role provides advanced technical expertise, third-tier support, and engineering solutions that improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance the overall user experience. The position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of the Bank's endpoint computing environment through proactive administration, automation, and continuous improvement. The End-User Computing Engineer leverages technical expertise to support modern workplace technologies, streamline operations, and deliver solutions that align with the Bank's business objectives and technology strategy. Operating with a high degree of ownership and accountability, the End-User Computing Engineer identifies improvement opportunities, resolves complex technical issues, implements technology enhancements, and helps ensure that employees have secure and reliable access to the systems and tools they need to perform their work effectively.
